Name: DiagnosticsHub Reports
Notes: Visual Studio Diagnostics Hub report folders. Old profiling sessions can be removed.
CleanupHint: Delete after confirming no active Visual Studio profiling session.

Name: Crash Dumps
Notes: Crash dumps help investigate failures. Keep recent dumps you still need.

Name: User Temp Items
Notes: General user temp files. Delete only after related apps are closed.

Name: Direct3D Shader Cache
Notes: Windows shader cache. It will be rebuilt as needed.

Name: NVIDIA DX Cache
Notes: GPU driver shader cache. It can be rebuilt.

Name: NVIDIA GL Cache
Notes: OpenGL cache files. They can be rebuilt.

Name: UWP TempState
Notes: Per-app temporary state for Store apps. Close the app before cleanup.

Name: UWP LocalCache
Notes: Per-app cache. Review because some apps use this path for offline data.

Name: Chrome Code Cache
Notes: Chrome code cache. Close Chrome before cleanup.

Name: Edge Code Cache
Notes: Edge code cache. Close Edge before cleanup.
